title: Fix 3 bugs in python_path_migration file_utils functions
description: Brownfield Python dirty scenario: list_text_files, read_if_exists, and ensure_dir each have a bug. Fix them so all 5 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/file_utils.py so all 5 tests pass.

  def list_text_files(directory):
    — filters for .md files instead of .txt
    — fix: change name.endswith(".md") to name.endswith(".txt")

  def read_if_exists(path):
    — always returns None without checking if file exists
    — fix: restore the os.path.exists check and open the file to read its contents

  def ensure_dir(path):
    — never creates the directory (os.makedirs call is missing)
    — fix: add `if not os.path.isdir(path): os.makedirs(path)` before the return

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: read_if_exists returns file contents or None
ensure_dir creates the directory if missing
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.file_utils import list_text_files, read_if_exists, ensure_dir" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.file_utils import list_text_files, read_if_exists, ensure_dir"
